scientific_integrity: Analytical proof plus separately executable finite checker; neither exhaustive small-size testing nor literature search is a universal proof of originality. No independent scientific validation has occurred.
scientific_limitations: Only binary strict-neighbor-majority fixed states on labeled simple unweighted prisms with n>=3, not period-two oscillations, attractions, or typical consensus. Underlying cycle fixed-point and internal-partition facts are prior work. Possible equivalent Ising-metastability enumeration is an unresolved literature-priority risk.
title: Exact fixed-point and opinion-balance spectrum of strict majority on prism networks
